purpose: Improve character consistency for storyboard generation by creating production-grade multi-angle character sheets.
why_this_matters: Single portrait references are good for face identity but weak for full-body costume continuity.
Video-stage Gemini experimental file_ids cannot reliably bind multiple reference roles, so character consistency should be solved upstream in storyboard generation.
A turnaround sheet provides front, side, back, three-quarter views, costume details, and key props in one image that storyboard prompts can cite as the character source of truth.

sheet_requirements.layout: cinematic production character reference board, one large face portrait on the left, eight full-body turnarounds across the top/right, lower panels for costume material, prop details, and accessory close-ups
avoid: text labels if the model writes gibberish
overdesigned armor unless character requires it

usage_policy.storyboard_stage: Use turnaround sheets as character design references in storyboard prompts and image workflows.
usage_policy.video_stage: Do not feed multiple character sheets into Gemini experimental I2V unless explicitly testing; prefer single approved storyboard as video input.
usage_policy.review: A sheet is usable only if face, costume, prop, and back/side views are internally consistent.
